field.label: SMS provider
field.comment: Who sends text messages. With one provider installed it is used automatically.

field.label: WhatsApp provider
field.comment: Who sends WhatsApp messages. With one provider installed it is used automatically.

group.label: Twilio
group.comment: Text and WhatsApp messages through your Twilio account.

field.label: Auth token
field.comment: Signs and authorizes the requests both ways; stored encrypted.

field.label: Messaging Service SID
field.comment: Recommended for SMS (MG…): Twilio picks the sending number and handles STOP and START. Used for WhatsApp too when no WhatsApp number is set.

field.label: SMS number
field.comment: The sending number in E.164 (e.g. +14155550100), when no Messaging Service is set.

field.label: WhatsApp number
field.comment: The WhatsApp sender in E.164, approved in Twilio.

field.label: Public URL
field.comment: The shop's public HTTPS address as Twilio calls it, e.g. https://shop.example. Twilio's signature covers this exact URL. Empty: the store's secure base URL. In the Twilio Console, set the number's (or Messaging Service's) incoming message webhook to {public URL}/cktwilio/webhook/inbound (HTTP POST); delivery status is requested per message.

field.label: Opt-in confirmation
field.comment: One text to a number's first sign-up in the website, as US carriers require. A new cart of the same number gets none.

field.label: Opt-in confirmation text
field.comment: {{store}} is the store's name. WhatsApp sends a template instead: map "twilio_optin" below.

field.label: WhatsApp templates
field.comment: Per notification type (e.g. twilio_optin, or your own WhatsApp notification type) and locale (e.g. de_DE, de, or empty for any): the approved template's Content SID (HX…) and the notification's variables for {{1}}, {{2}}, … (e.g. store for twilio_optin).
